name: InSimology
source:
You play as a young boy living in an Indian family somewhere in the world. You have absolutely no problems in your life but things will start taking turns as you explore your life and face the unknown truth about your father. Will you be able to keep your family safe or....​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/insimology-v1-4-capr.108234/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个生活在世界某个地方的印度家庭的小男孩。你的生活绝对没有任何问题，但当你探索自己的生活并面对关于你父亲的未知真相时，事情就会开始轮流发生。你能保证家人的安全吗，或者……​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/insimology-v1-4-capr.108234/]F95Zone[/url]]
